## Upcoming events

::: {.event-list}

```{r}
#| output: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

source("./mailing/mailing.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

events <- read_excel('event_list.xlsx')  %>% filter(date>=today())

for (i in 1:nrow(events)) {
  e <- events[i,]
  cat('<details class="event-card">')
  cat('<summary>')
  cat('<div class="event-date">')
  cat('<span class="event-day">')
  cat(e$day)
  cat('</span>')
  cat('<span class="event-month">')
  cat(e$month)
  cat('</span>')
  cat('<span class="event-year">')
  cat(e$year)
  cat('</span>')
  cat('</div>')
  cat('<div class="event-summary">')
  cat('<span class="event-type">')
  cat(e$type)
  cat('</span>')
  cat('<h3>')
  cat(e$title)
  cat('</h3>')
  cat('<p class="event-people">')
  cat(e$people)
  cat('</p>')
  cat('<p class="event-affiliation">')
  cat(e$affiliation)
  cat('</p>')
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</summary>')
  cat('<div class="event-details">')
  cat(e$details)
  cat('</div>')
  cat('</details>')
}

```

## Past events



```{r}
#| output: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

source("./mailing/mailing.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

events <- read_excel('event_list.xlsx')  %>% filter(date<today())

years <- events$year %>% unique() %>% sort(decreasing = T)

for (y in years) {
  cat('<details class="past-events-section"><summary><h3>',y,'</h3></summary>')
  cat('::: {.event-list .past-events}\n\n')
  for (i in 1:nrow(events %>% filter(year==y))) {
    e <- events[i,]
    cat('<details class="event-card">')
    cat('<summary>')
    cat('<div class="event-date">')
    cat('<span class="event-day">')
    cat(e$day)
    cat('</span>')
    cat('<span class="event-month">')
    cat(e$month)
    cat('</span>')
    cat('<span class="event-year">')
    cat(e$year)
    cat('</span>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('<div class="event-summary">')
    cat('<span class="event-type">')
    cat(e$type)
    cat('</span>')
    cat('<h3>')
    cat(e$title)
    cat('</h3>')
    cat('<p class="event-people">')
    cat(e$people)
    cat('</p>')
    cat('<p class="event-affiliation">')
    cat(e$affiliation)
    cat('</p>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</summary>')
    cat('<div class="event-details">')
    cat(e$details)
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</details>')
  }
  cat(':::\n\n')
  cat('</details>')
}

```
